quote: Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires models to jointly understand an image and a natural language question.
We focus on image, question VQA samples and aim to quantify their difficulty, i.e., how challenging it is for a model to answer them correctly.
During inference, the answer with the highest probability is evaluated against the pattern of N ground-truth answers.
outputs: Generated natural language answers to visual questions
